test_overview: Evaluated 7 steps of the offline-capable Marketplace app against the test plan. Steps 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 all passed. Step 3 failed: navigating to the private Seller Status Page link (SELLER_LINK_1 for Coffee Maker) while OFFLINE rendered the server 404 error page ('Oops! Invalid seller link') instead of the expected Seller Status Page rendered from local data (pending listing shell from the local outbox). The fatal verification 'The Seller Status Page loads (from local data)' was not satisfied, so step 3 was awarded 0 points. All other functionality worked: two listings (Coffee Maker, Blender) queued offline with immediate seller links and offline indicator; pending indicator showed exactly 2 waiting items and persisted across Home/Browse; auto-sync on reconnect emptied the pending queue ('All synced') and both listings appeared in Browse; a BUYER placed an order for Coffee Maker; both seller confirm and cancel were correctly blocked while offline (buttons disabled, status remained '⏳ Pending Order') with connectivity-required messages; and confirming payment online succeeded, transitioning the status to '✅ Sold'. Final score 38/42.

steps.description: test_create_multiple_listings_offline: PASS. Created Coffee Maker and Blender while offline, each queued for sync with an immediate private seller link; offline indicator visible.

test_pending_indicator_shows_multiple_items: PASS. Indicator showed exactly 2 items waiting to sync; both Coffee Maker and Blender identifiable with waiting status; indicator persisted across Home and Browse.

test_pending_seller_page_accessible_offline: FAIL. Navigating to SELLER_LINK_1 while offline rendered the 404 'Oops! Invalid seller link' error page instead of the Seller Status Page loaded from local data.
test_sync_multiple_listings_on_reconnect: PASS. On reconnect, auto-sync triggered; pending cleared to 'All synced'; both Coffee Maker and Blender appeared in Browse.
setup_create_pending_order: PASS. BUYER placed an order for Coffee Maker (Name Test Buyer, email, phone); 'Order Placed!' confirmed.

test_seller_confirm_and_cancel_blocked_offline: PASS. Both confirm and cancel were blocked while offline (buttons disabled, status remained Pending Order) and a connectivity-required toast message was shown for each.
test_seller_action_succeeds_online: PASS. Reconnected; offline indicator disappeared; confirm payment succeeded and status updated to Sold.
